topic: Ahimsa Philosophy in Jain Caves of Ellora
short_description: Exploration of the 9th-century Digambara Jain shrines at Ellora Caves.
body:
Ahimsa in Stone: Ellora Jain Shrines

The Caves 30 to 34 at Ellora celebrate the severe austerity and spiritual tranquility of Tirthankaras carved directly into basalt.
